mathematical_engine: variance-risk-premium capture under executable bid/ask with static delta hedge and explicit tail-risk accounting
mechanism_statement: Option buyers pay an insurance/convexity premium for protection against large BTC moves; option sellers receive that premium in exchange for short-volatility and crash exposure. The experiment asks whether the premium remains positive after executable spreads, hedge costs, fees and tail losses.
expected_sign_or_payoff_shape: high-frequency small/moderate gains with negative skew and episodic tail losses; positive mean is insufficient unless tail and drawdown gates also survive
failure_mode: bid/ask and hedge costs consume the premium, sparse executable quotes collapse sample size, or rare crash losses dominate long-run expectancy
regime_dependency: expected to be sensitive to volatility level, jump risk and liquidity regime; no regime filter is authorized in this MVE

source_authority.canonical_source: Tardis.dev Deribit point-in-time options_chain + quotes, or equivalently authoritative historical BBO corpus
source_authority.point_in_time_requirement: all instrument selection and entry/exit quotes must be timestamp-valid with no future information and no midpoint substitution
source_authority.coverage_gate: at least 120 executable frozen weekly anchors from 2021-04-01 through 2024-11-28 before any performance verdict

execution_assumptions.cost_model: Deribit option fees + BTC perpetual taker fees + explicit adverse-tick/slippage stress
execution_assumptions.entry_exit: short same-strike ATM-ish 25-35 DTE call+put at executable bids; close after seven days at executable asks; static initial BTC perpetual delta hedge

validation_path: source acquisition -> deterministic BBO execution census -> base/stress performance -> block bootstrap -> yearly stability -> protected holdout only under separate future authority
promotion_policy_reference: pre-frozen numerical gates in EXECUTION_BBO_AUTHORITY_V0.2.json; no post-outcome rescue
material_difference_from_existing_work: execution evidence source changes from sparse public trade prints to point-in-time historical BBO; economic rules are deliberately preserved and no regime filter is added
expected_correlation_bucket: short-volatility / option-premium carry; conceptually distinct from trend, forced-flow and event-directional systems
